name: Zjnav (终极导航)

sources.title: 投稿须知 / 网站提交 — Chinese submission rules page; reciprocal link required, login required, 7-15 day review

conditions: Must first add a reciprocal link to 终极导航 (https://www.zjnav.com/) on your site — '无本站链接不会收录' (no link back = not included)
Login required: the submission form is behind '需要登录才能访问' — an account on zjnav.com is needed
Rule 6 says high-quality sites may be exempted from the reciprocal link at editor discretion
requirements: Site must load normally — '不收录在正常情况下无法正常连接或打开时间太长的网站'
Site must have substantive content — no under-construction or empty sites
Must pick the correct category (there is an AI工具/AI导航 section); wrong category = automatic rejection
Chinese-language directory — primary audience is mainland China (ICP备案 site); English-only SaaS may still be accepted but evaluate audience fit
They periodically re-check listings and remove sites violating standards
preparation: Add their friend link first: name '终极导航', URL https://www.zjnav.com/, description '实用的资源网址导航收藏夹', icon https://www.zjnav.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/1660466052-ico.png
Site name, URL, description, logo — presumably in Chinese
Pick the right category (AI工具/AI导航 for AI products)
workflow: Place the reciprocal link on your site
Open https://www.zjnav.com/tougao (网站提交) and fill the submission form with correct category
Wait — published review window is 7-15 days
Keep the reciprocal link live — they re-check periodically
watchFor: Free path is a link exchange — removing their badge later risks delisting
Old 'reviewed daily at 22:00' note is struck through; real queue is now 7-15 days
Submission UI and rules are Chinese-only — need translation for an agent
China-hosted site; latency/accessibility for non-CN visitors is a consideration
countsAsLive: The site appears as a listed entry under the chosen zjnav.com category page (e.g. AI导航) with a working outbound link
unknowns: Whether reciprocal-link exemption ('优质的网站') is applied proactively or by request
Link attribute on outbound listing links
Whether non-Chinese sites are routinely accepted
